_readme: The seven apps on the home page walk, in order. Run python3 _products/walk-gen.py after editing. Each app's name sits on one line (en + ko), so a rename is a one-line change. Facts come only from the repo, the site and the App Store. Anything marked TODO still needs facts from 유일 님.

line.en: A live Mac screen on your iPad, with touch, keyboard and clipboard going back.
line.ko: Mac 화면을 iPad에 띄우고, 터치와 키보드, 클립보드를 다시 Mac으로 보냅니다.

what.en: A remote desktop app for your tablet. See your computer screen and control it with touch, trackpad and keyboard.
what.ko: 태블릿용 원격 데스크톱 앱이에요. 컴퓨터 화면을 보면서 터치, 트랙패드, 키보드로 조작해요.

for.en: iPad, iPhone and Vision Pro owners with an Apple silicon Mac.
for.ko: Apple 실리콘 Mac과 iPad, iPhone, Vision Pro를 함께 쓰는 사람.

line.en: An iPad app for classroom presentation and annotation.

what.en: An iPad app for classroom presentation and annotation, designed around the materials teachers already use.
what.ko: 선생님이 이미 쓰는 자료를 중심으로 설계한 아이패드 수업·판서 앱입니다.

for.en: teachers who present lessons on an iPad.

en: Work with PPTX, PDF and HTML teaching materials
Support teaching in English and Korean
ko: PPTX, PDF, HTML 수업 자료 사용

line.en: Exam authoring, grading and analysis in one workflow.
line.ko: 시험 출제, 채점, 분석을 하나의 흐름으로.

what.en: A Python-based application for exam authoring, grading and analysis, bringing related assessment tasks into one workflow.
what.ko: 시험 출제, 채점, 분석을 하나의 흐름으로 묶는 Python 기반 프로그램입니다.

for.en: people who write, grade and review exams.

line.en: Five-in-a-row where every stone is a small character.

what.en: A five-in-a-row board game for iPhone and iPad, where every stone is a small character with its own look.
what.ko: 아이폰과 아이패드에서 즐기는 오목 게임입니다. 돌 하나하나가 저마다 모습을 가진 작은 캐릭터입니다.

en: Stone characters with their own style
Built natively for iPhone and iPad
